title.zh: 卷三百九十二 列傳第一百五十一 趙汝愚子:崇憲
title.en: Volume 392 Biographies 151: Zhao Ruyu and son: Chongxian
title.raw: 卷三百九十二 列傳第一百五十一 趙汝愚子:崇憲 Volume 392 Biographies 151: Zhao Ruyu and son: Chongxian

sentences.zh: 趙汝愚

translations.literal: Zhao Ruyu
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ruyu

sentences.zh: 趙汝愚，字子直，漢恭憲王元佐七世孫，居饒之餘干縣。

translations.literal: Zhao Ruyu, style name Zizhi, was a seventh-generation descendant of Prince Gongxian of Han, Prince Yuansuo, and resided in Yugan County in Rao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ruyu, whose style name was Zizhi, was a seventh-generation descendant of Prince Gongxian of Han, Prince Yuansuo, and lived in Yugan County, Rao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父善應，字彥遠，官終修武郎、江西兵馬都監。

translations.literal: His father Shan Ying, style name Yanyuan, ultimately held the offices of Xiuyu Lang and Jiangxi Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shan Ying, style name Yanyuan, rose to the posts of Xiuyu Lang and Jiangxi Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 性純孝，親病，嘗刺血和藥以進。

translations.literal: By nature he was purely filial; when his parents were ill, he once pricked his finger and mixed the blood with medicine to present to them.
translations.idiomatic: He was utterly devoted in filial piety; when his parents fell ill, he once drew his own blood, mixed it with their medicine, and presented it to them.

sentences.zh: 母畏雷，每聞雷則披衣走其所。

translations.literal: His mother feared thunder; whenever she heard thunder he would throw on his clothes and run to where she was.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was afraid of thunder; whenever she heard it, he would throw on his clothes and hurry to her side.

sentences.zh: 嘗寒夜遠歸，從者將扣門，遽止之曰：「無恐吾母。

translations.literal: Once on a cold night he returned from afar; when his attendants were about to knock at the gate, he hastily stopped them, saying, "Do not frighten my mother."
translations.idiomatic: Once, returning from afar on a bitter cold night, he saw his attendants about to knock at the gate and stopped them at once: "Do not frighten my mother."

sentences.zh: 」露坐達明，門啟而後入。

translations.literal: He sat in the open until daybreak, and only entered after the gate was opened.
translations.idiomatic: He sat outside in the open until dawn and entered only after the gate was opened.

sentences.zh: 家貧，諸弟未制衣不敢制，已制未服不敢服，一瓜果之微必相待共嘗之。

translations.literal: The family was poor; he would not have clothes made until his younger brothers had theirs made, nor wear them until his brothers had worn theirs; even the smallest fruit or melon had to be waited for and tasted together.
translations.idiomatic: The household was poor: he would not have a garment made until his younger brothers had theirs, nor wear one until they had worn theirs; even the smallest fruit or melon had to be shared before anyone tasted it.

sentences.zh: 母喪，哭泣嘔血，毀瘠骨立，終日俯首柩傍，聞雷猶起，側立垂涕。

translations.literal: When his mother died, he wept until he vomited blood, wasted away until only skin and bone remained, bowed his head beside the coffin all day long, and still rose at the sound of thunder, standing aside with tears streaming down.
translations.idiomatic: At his mother's death he wept until he vomited blood, wasted away to skin and bone, and spent the whole day bowed beside her coffin; he still rose at thunder, stood aside, and wept.

sentences.zh: 既終喪，言及其親，未嘗不揮涕，生朝必哭於廟。

translations.literal: After the mourning period ended, whenever he spoke of his parents he never failed to wipe away tears; on his birthday he would always weep at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning ended, he never spoke of his parents without brushing away tears, and on his own birthday he would always weep at the family shrine.

sentences.zh: 父終肺疾，每膳不忍以諸肺爲羞。

translations.literal: His father died of lung disease; at every meal he could not bear to serve any lung dish as a delicacy.
translations.idiomatic: His father had died of lung disease, and at every meal he could not bear to set out lung dishes among the delicacies.

sentences.zh: 母生歲值卯，謂卯兔神也，終其身不食兔。

translations.literal: His mother was born in a mao year; he said the mao year was the Year of the Rabbit god, and for his entire life he never ate rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: His mother had been born in a mao year; he held that mao was the sign of the Rabbit god and never ate rabbit for the rest of his life.

sentences.zh: 聞四方水旱，輒憂形於色。

translations.literal: Whenever he heard of flood or drought anywhere in the realm, worry showed on his face.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he heard of flood or drought anywhere in the empire, distress showed plainly on his face.

sentences.zh: 江、淮警報至，爲之流涕，不食累日；

translations.literal: When alarms from the Jiang and Huai reached him, he wept for them and went without food for days on end.
translations.idiomatic: When alarms came from the Jiang and Huai regions, he wept over them and went without food for days on end;

sentences.zh: 同僚會宴，善應悵然曰：「此寧諸君樂飲時耶！

translations.literal: At a banquet with colleagues, Shan Ying said mournfully, "Is this really the time for you gentlemen to drink in pleasure?"
translations.idiomatic: at a banquet with colleagues Shan Ying said mournfully, "Is this really a time for you gentlemen to drink and make merry?"

sentences.zh: 」衆爲失色而罷。

translations.literal: The assembly turned pale and broke up.
translations.idiomatic: The company turned pale and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 故人之孤女，貧無所歸，善應聘以爲己子婦。

translations.literal: An orphaned daughter of an old friend, destitute with nowhere to go, Shan Ying took her as wife for his own son.
translations.idiomatic: An old friend's orphaned daughter, poor and with nowhere to go, Shan Ying took her in marriage for his own son.

sentences.zh: 有嘗同僚者死不克葬，子傭食他所，善應馳往哭之，歸其子而予之貲，使葬焉。

translations.literal: A former colleague had died unable to afford burial; his son was hired out for food elsewhere; Shan Ying galloped to weep over the corpse, brought the son back, and gave him money to bury the father.
translations.idiomatic: A former colleague died without means for burial; his son was working elsewhere for food. Shan Ying galloped to weep over the body, brought the son back, gave him funds, and had the father buried.

sentences.zh: 道見病者必收恤之，躬爲煮藥。

translations.literal: Whenever he saw the sick on the road he would always take them in and care for them, personally boiling medicine for them.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he met the sick on the road he took them in and cared for them, personally brewing their medicine.

sentences.zh: 歲饑，旦夕率其家人輟食之半，以飼饑者。

translations.literal: In years of famine, morning and evening he led his household to set aside half their food to feed the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: In famine years he led his household morning and evening to set aside half their food to feed the starving.

sentences.zh: 夏不去草，冬不破壤，懼百蟲之遊且蟄者失其所也。

translations.literal: In summer he would not clear away grass, in winter he would not break the soil, for fear that the hundred insects roaming and hibernating would lose their proper places.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he would not clear grass, in winter he would not break the earth, lest the myriad insects abroad or in hibernation lose their proper places.

sentences.zh: 晉陵尤袤稱之曰：「古君子也。

translations.literal: You Mao of Jinling praised him, saying, "An ancient-style gentleman."
translations.idiomatic: You Mao of Jinling praised him, saying, "A gentleman in the ancient manner."

sentences.zh: 」既卒，丞相陳俊卿題其墓碣曰：「宋篤行趙公彥遠之墓」。

translations.literal: After he died, the chief councilor Chen Junqi inscribed his tomb tablet: "The Tomb of the Devoted in Conduct Lord Zhao Yanyuan of Song."
translations.idiomatic: After his death, Chief Councilor Chen Junqi inscribed his tomb stele: "The Tomb of Lord Zhao Yanyuan of Song, Devoted in Conduct."

sentences.zh: 汝愚早有大志，每曰：「丈夫得汗青一幅紙，始不負此生。

translations.literal: Ruyu from early on had great ambition; he often said, "A man is not unworthy of this life until he earns a place on the green-covered scroll."
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu had held great ambitions from youth and often said, "A man has not lived in vain until he earns his place on the green-covered scroll."

sentences.zh: 」擢進士第一，簽書寧國軍節度判官，召試館職，除祕書省正字。

translations.literal: He placed first among jinshi graduates, was appointed as signing clerk for the Ningguo Military Commission, was summoned for examination as a staff member at the Directorate of Education, and was made Corrector of Texts at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He ranked first among jinshi graduates, was appointed signing clerk to the Ningguo Military Commission, was summoned to examination for an academy post, and was made Corrector of Texts in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 孝宗方銳意恢復，始見，即陳自治之策，孝宗稱善，遷校書郎。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong was then keen on restoration; at their first meeting Ruyu immediately presented his policies for self-governance, which Xiaozong praised, and he was promoted to collating editor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong was then intent on recovery; at their first meeting Ruyu at once set forth policies for restoring order, which Xiaozong praised, and he was promoted to collating editor.

sentences.zh: 知閤門張說擢簽書樞密院事，汝愚不往見，率同列請祠，未報。

translations.literal: Zhang Yue, Director of the Palace Gate Department, was promoted to Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Ruyu did not call on him and led his colleagues in petitioning for temple appointment; he received no response.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue, Director of the Palace Gate Department, was promoted to acting commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Ruyu refused to call on him and led his colleagues in petitioning for temple appointment, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 會祖母訃至，即日歸，因自劾，上不加罪。

translations.literal: When his grandmother's death announcement arrived, he returned home that same day and impeached himself; the emperor did not impose punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When word came of his grandmother's death, he returned home that same day and impeached himself; the emperor imposed no penalty.

sentences.zh: 遷著作郎、知信州，易台州，除江西轉運判官，入爲吏部郎兼太子侍講。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Compiler at the Palace Library and Prefect of Xin Prefecture, transferred to Taizhou, made Jiangxi Transport Commissioner, and entered the capital as Minister of Personnel and Concurrent Lecturer to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to compiler, made prefect of Xin Prefecture, transferred to Taizhou, appointed Jiangxi transport commissioner, and entered the capital as director in the Ministry of Personnel and concurrent lecturer to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 遷祕書少監兼權給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Secretariat and Acting Director of the Department of Service.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director of the Secretariat and acting director of the Department of Service.

sentences.zh: 內侍陳源有寵于德壽宮，添差浙西副總管。

translations.literal: The inner attendant Chen Yuan was favored at the Deshou Palace; he was additionally assigned as Deputy Commander-in-Chief of Zhexi.
translations.idiomatic: The inner attendant Chen Yuan enjoyed favor at Deshou Palace and was given an additional assignment as deputy commander-in-chief of Zhexi.

sentences.zh: 汝愚言：「祖宗以童貫典兵，卒開邊釁，源不宜使居總戎之任。

translations.literal: Ruyu said: "Our ancestors placed Tong Guan in charge of troops and in the end opened border troubles; Yuan should not be allowed to hold overall military command."
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu said, "Our ancestors placed Tong Guan in charge of troops and in the end opened border troubles; Yuan ought not hold overall military command."

sentences.zh: 」孝宗喜，詔自今內侍不得兼兵職。

translations.literal: Xiaozong was pleased and decreed that from then on inner attendants might not concurrently hold military posts.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozong was pleased and decreed that from then on inner attendants might not concurrently hold military posts.

sentences.zh: 舊制，密院文書皆經門下省，張說在西府，託言邊機不宜泄。

translations.literal: By established practice, documents of the Bureau of Military Affairs all passed through the Department of Service; Zhang Yue in the Western Office claimed that border affairs ought not to be leaked.
translations.idiomatic: By established practice, Bureau of Military Affairs documents all passed through the Department of Service; Zhang Yue in the Western Office claimed that border affairs ought not be disclosed.

sentences.zh: 汝愚謂：「東西二府朝廷治亂所關，中書庶政無一不由東省，何密院不然？

translations.literal: Ruyu argued: "The Eastern and Western Offices are what the court's order and disorder depend on; at the Central Secretariat there is not a single matter of ordinary government that does not go through the Eastern Office—why should the Military Commission be different?"
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu argued, "The Eastern and Western Offices bear on whether the court is well or ill governed; at the Central Secretariat not a single matter of ordinary government fails to pass through the Eastern Office—why should the Military Commission be different?"

sentences.zh: 」孝宗命如舊制。

translations.literal: Xiaozong ordered that the old practice be followed.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozong ordered the former practice restored.

sentences.zh: 權吏部侍郎兼太子右庶子，論知閤王抃招權預政，出抃外祠。

translations.literal: Acting Vice Minister of Personnel and Concurrent Right Subtutor to the Crown Prince, he memorialized that Wang Bian of the Palace Gate Department was monopolizing power and meddling in government, and Bian was sent out on temple appointment.
translations.idiomatic: As acting vice minister of personnel and concurrent right subtutor to the crown prince, he memorialized that Wang Bian of the Palace Gate Department was monopolizing power and meddling in government; Bian was sent out on temple appointment.

sentences.zh: 以集英殿修撰帥福建，陛辭，言國事之大者四，其一謂：「吳氏四世專蜀兵，非國家之利，請及今以漸抑之。

translations.literal: As Compiler at the Hall of Assembled Heroes he commanded Fujian; at his audience on departure he spoke on four great matters of state policy, the first saying: "The Wu clan for four generations has monopolized Sichuan troops; this is not to the state's advantage—please gradually restrain them now, while there is still time."
translations.idiomatic: As compiler at the Hall of Assembled Heroes he took command in Fujian; at his audience on departure he spoke on four great matters of state, the first being: "The Wu clan for four generations has monopolized Sichuan troops—this is not to the state's advantage; please begin gradually to restrain them while there is still time."

sentences.zh: 」進直學士、制置四川兼知成都府。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Academician at the Hall of Assembled Heroes and Commissioner for Sichuan while also serving as Prefect of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to academician and made commissioner for Sichuan while also serving as prefect of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 諸羌蠻相挻爲邊患，汝愚至，悉以計分其勢。

translations.literal: The various Qiang and barbarian tribes were stirring up border troubles; when Ruyu arrived, he used stratagems to divide their power.
translations.idiomatic: The various Qiang and barbarian tribes were stirring one another into border trouble; when Ruyu arrived, he used stratagems to divide their strength.

sentences.zh: 孝宗謂其有文武威風，召還。

translations.literal: Xiaozong said he had both civil and military prestige and summoned him back.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozong said he possessed both civil and military authority and summoned him back.

sentences.zh: 光宗受禪，趣召未至，殿中侍御史范處義論其稽命，除知潭州，辭，改太平州。

translations.literal: When Guangzong received the abdication, urgent summons were issued but he had not yet arrived; the Palace Censor Fan Chuyi criticized his delay in obeying orders and he was made Prefect of Tan Prefecture; he declined and was transferred to Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangzong received the abdication, urgent summons went out but Ruyu had not yet arrived; Palace Censor Fan Chuyi criticized his delay in obeying orders; he was made prefect of Tan Prefecture, declined, and was transferred to Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 進敷文閣學士，知福州。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Academician at the Hall of Spreading Culture and made Prefect of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to academician at the Hall of Spreading Culture and made prefect of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 紹熙二年，召爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxi he was summoned to be Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shaoxi he was summoned to be minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 先是，高宗以宮人黃氏侍光宗於東宮，及即位爲貴妃，后李氏意不能平。

translations.literal: Previously, Gaozong had given a palace woman of the Huang clan to serve Guangzong in the Eastern Palace; when he took the throne she became Noble Consort, and the Empress née Li could not be at peace in mind.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Gaozong had given a palace woman of the Huang clan to attend Guangzong in the Eastern Palace; when he took the throne she became noble consort, and Empress Li could not be at ease in mind.

sentences.zh: 是年冬十一月郊，有司已戒而風雨暴至，光宗震懼，及齋宿青城，貴妃暴薨，駕還，聞之恚，是夕疾作。

translations.literal: That winter in the eleventh month was the suburban sacrifice; the relevant offices had already issued warnings when violent wind and rain burst upon them; Guangzong was terrified, and while observing fasts at the Azure City the Noble Consort died suddenly; when the imperial carriage returned and he heard of it he was enraged, and that night his illness broke out.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, came the suburban sacrifice; the relevant offices had already issued warnings when violent wind and rain burst upon them. Guangzong was terrified; while he was observing fasts at the Azure City the noble consort died suddenly. When the imperial carriage returned and he heard of it he was enraged, and that night his illness broke out.

sentences.zh: 內侍馳白孝宗，孝宗倉卒至南內，問所以致疾之由，不免有所戒責。

translations.literal: An inner attendant galloped to inform Xiaozong; Xiaozong rushed in haste to the Southern Inner Palace and asked the cause of the illness, unavoidably offering reproof and blame.
translations.idiomatic: An inner attendant galloped to inform Xiaozong; Xiaozong rushed in haste to the Southern Inner Palace, asked what had caused the illness, and could not avoid offering reproof.

sentences.zh: 及光宗疾稍平，汝愚入對。

translations.literal: When Guangzong's illness had eased somewhat, Ruyu entered audience.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangzong's illness had eased somewhat, Ruyu entered audience.

sentences.zh: 上常以五日一朝孝宗于重華宮，至是往往以傳旨免，至會慶節上壽，駕不出，冬至朝賀又不出，都人以爲憂。

translations.literal: The emperor had customarily on the fifth day of each month attended on Xiaozong at the Chonghua Palace; by this time he often exempted himself through transmitted orders; when the Birthday of Joint Celebration arrived he did not go out for the birthday tribute, and again did not go out for the winter solstice court congratulation—the people of the capital were anxious.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had customarily on the fifth of each month attended Xiaozong at Chonghua Palace; by this time he often excused himself through transmitted orders. When the Birthday of Joint Celebration came he did not go out to offer birthday felicitations; at the winter solstice he again failed to appear for court congratulation—and the people of the capital were troubled.

sentences.zh: 汝愚往復規諫，上意乃悟。

translations.literal: Ruyu went back and forth repeatedly remonstrating, and the emperor's mind was brought to understanding.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu went back and forth remonstrating until the emperor's mind was brought to understanding.

sentences.zh: 汝愚又屬嗣秀王伯圭調護，於是兩宮之情通。

translations.literal: Ruyu also entrusted the heir-apparent prince Bo Gui of the Xiu branch to mediate and protect relations, and thus feelings between the two palaces were connected.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu also entrusted Heir Apparent Prince Bo Gui of the Xiu branch to mediate, and thus feelings between the two palaces were restored.

sentences.zh: 光宗及后俱詣北內，從容竟日。

translations.literal: Guangzong and the empress both went to the Northern Inner Palace and passed the day at ease together.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzong and the empress both went to the Northern Inner Palace and spent the day together at ease.

sentences.zh: 四年，汝愚知貢舉，與監察御史汪義端有違言。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Ruyu was in charge of the metropolitan examination and had angry words with the Investigating Censor Wang Yiduan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Ruyu was in charge of the metropolitan examination and had angry words with Investigating Censor Wang Yiduan.

sentences.zh: 汝愚除同知樞密院事，義端言祖宗之法，宗室不爲執政，詆汝愚植黨沽名，疏上，不納。

translations.literal: Ruyu was appointed Acting Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yiduan cited ancestral law that persons of the imperial clan might not serve as chancellor, and slandered Ruyu for forming factions and trading on reputation; the memorial went up but was not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu was appointed acting vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yiduan cited ancestral law that members of the imperial clan might not serve as chancellor and slandered Ruyu for forming factions and trading on reputation; the memorial went up but was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 又論臺諫、給舍陰附汝愚，一切緘默，不報。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that the censors and remonstrators and the drafters and attendants were secretly siding with Ruyu and all remained silent; again no response.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that the censors, remonstrators, drafters, and attendants were secretly siding with Ruyu and all remained silent; again there was no response.

sentences.zh: 論汝愚發策譏訕祖宗，又不報。

translations.literal: He memorialized that Ruyu's examination questions mocked the ancestors; again no response.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that Ruyu's examination questions mocked the ancestors; again no response.

sentences.zh: 汝愚力辭，上爲徙義端軍器監。

translations.literal: Ruyu strenuously declined; the emperor moved Yiduan to the Directorate of Armaments.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu strenuously declined; the emperor transferred Yiduan to the Directorate of Armaments.

sentences.zh: 給事中黃裳言：「汝愚事親孝，事君忠，居官廉，憂國愛民，出於天性。

translations.literal: The Attendant-draftee Huang Shang said: "Ruyu is filial to his parents, loyal to his sovereign, incorrupt in office, and concerned for the state and loving toward the people—all from his inborn nature."
translations.idiomatic: Attendant-draftee Huang Shang said, "Ruyu is filial toward his parents, loyal toward his sovereign, incorrupt in office, and concerned for the state and loving toward the people—all from his inborn nature."

sentences.zh: 義端實忌賢，不可以不黜。

translations.literal: "Yiduan truly envies the worthy and may not be left undismissed."
translations.idiomatic: "Yiduan truly envies the worthy and cannot be left undismissed."

sentences.zh: 」上乃黜義端補郡，汝愚不獲已拜命。

translations.literal: The emperor then dismissed Yiduan to a prefectural post, and Ruyu, unable to do otherwise, accepted the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then dismissed Yiduan to a prefectural post, and Ruyu, unable to do otherwise, accepted the appointment.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷知樞密院事，辭不拜，有旨趣受告。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; he declined and did not bow to accept; an order was issued urging him to receive notice of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; he declined and did not bow to accept; an order was issued urging him to receive notice of appointment.

sentences.zh: 汝愚對曰：「臣非敢久辭。

translations.literal: Ruyu replied in audience: "Your subject does not dare decline for long."
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu replied in audience, "Your subject does not dare decline for long."

sentences.zh: 臣嘗論朝廷數事，其言未見用，今陛下過重華，留正復相，天下幸甚。

translations.literal: "Your subject has memorialized on several court matters, and my words have not been adopted; now Your Majesty is passing Chonghua and Liu Zheng is again chancellor—under Heaven is greatly fortunate."
translations.idiomatic: "Your subject has memorialized on several court matters, and my words have not been adopted; now Your Majesty is passing Chonghua and Liu Zheng is again chancellor—all under Heaven is greatly fortunate."

sentences.zh: 惟武興未除帥，臣心不敢安。

translations.literal: "Only Wuxing still lacks a commander; my heart cannot be at ease."
translations.idiomatic: "Only Wuxing still lacks a commander; my heart cannot be at ease."

sentences.zh: 」上遂以張詔代領武興軍，汝愚乃受命。

translations.literal: The emperor then had Zhang Zhao replace him in command of the Wuxing Army, and Ruyu thereupon accepted the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then had Zhang Zhao take command of the Wuxing Army in his place, and Ruyu thereupon accepted the appointment.

sentences.zh: 光宗之疾生於疑畏，其未過宮也，汝愚數從容進諫，光宗出聞其語輒悟，入輒復疑。

translations.literal: Guangzong's illness arose from suspicion and fear; before he visited the palace, Ruyu had repeatedly offered gentle remonstrance, and when Guangzong went out and heard his words he would understand at once, but inside he would again become suspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzong's illness arose from suspicion and fear; before he visited the palace, Ruyu had repeatedly offered gentle remonstrance—when Guangzong went out and heard his words he would understand at once, but inside he would again grow suspicious.

sentences.zh: 五年春，孝宗不豫，夏五月，疾日臻。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year Xiaozong was unwell; in the fifth month of summer the illness daily grew worse.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year Xiaozong was unwell; by the fifth month of summer the illness was daily growing worse.

sentences.zh: 光宗御後殿，丞相率同列入，請上詣重華宮侍疾，從臣、臺諫繼入，閤門吏以故事止之，不退。

translations.literal: Guangzong held court in the rear hall; the chief councilor led the assembled ministers in entering and requested that he go to Chonghua Palace to attend the sick; following ministers and censors entered in succession; the gate clerks stopped them according to precedent, but they did not withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzong held court in the rear hall; the chief councilor led the assembled ministers in and requested that he go to Chonghua Palace to attend the sick; following ministers and censors entered in succession; the gate clerks stopped them according to precedent, but they did not withdraw.

sentences.zh: 光宗益疑，起入內。

translations.literal: Guangzong grew still more suspicious and rose to go inside.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzong grew still more suspicious and rose to go inside.

sentences.zh: 越二日，宰相又請對，光宗令知閤門事韓侂胄傳旨云：「宰執並出。

translations.literal: Two days later the chief councilor again requested audience; Guangzong had Han Tuozhou of the Palace Gate Department transmit an order saying: "All councilors leave together."
translations.idiomatic: Two days later the chief councilor again requested audience; Guangzong had Han Tuozhou of the Palace Gate Department transmit an order: "All councilors leave together."

sentences.zh: 」於是俱至浙江亭俟命。

translations.literal: Thereupon they all went to the Zhejiang Pavilion to await orders.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they all went to the Zhejiang Pavilion to await orders.

sentences.zh: 孝宗聞之憂甚，嗣秀王簡丞相傳孝宗意，令宰執復入。

translations.literal: Xiaozong heard of this with great anxiety; the heir-apparent prince relayed Xiaozong's intent through the chief councilor, ordering the councilors to enter again.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozong heard of this with great anxiety; the heir-apparent prince relayed Xiaozong's intent through the chief councilor, ordering the councilors to enter again.

sentences.zh: 侂胄奏曰：「昨傳旨令宰執出殿門，今乃出都門。

translations.literal: Tuozhou memorialized: "Yesterday I transmitted an order to have the councilors leave the palace gate; now they have gone beyond the capital gate."
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou memorialized, "Yesterday I transmitted an order to have the councilors leave the palace gate; now they have gone beyond the capital gate."

sentences.zh: 」請自往宣押，汝愚等乃還第。

translations.literal: He requested to go himself to announce the imperial rescript; Ruyu and the others thereupon returned to their residences.
translations.idiomatic: He requested to go himself to announce the imperial rescript; Ruyu and the others thereupon returned to their residences.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，夜五鼓，重華大閹扣宰執私第，報孝宗崩，中書以聞，汝愚恐上疑，或不出視朝，持其劄不上。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day of the sixth month, at the fifth watch of the night, the great eunuch of Chonghua knocked at the councilors' private residences reporting Xiaozong's death; the Secretariat reported it upward; Ruyu feared the emperor might suspect something or fail to hold court, and withheld the memorial without submitting it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the sixth month, at the fifth watch of the night, the great eunuch of Chonghua knocked at the councilors' private residences to report Xiaozong's death; the Secretariat reported it upward; Ruyu feared the emperor might suspect something or fail to hold court and withheld the memorial without submitting it.

sentences.zh: 次日，上視朝，汝愚以提舉重華宮關禮狀進，上乃許過北內，至日昃不出，宰相率百官詣重華宮發喪。

translations.literal: The next day the emperor held court; Ruyu entered a memorial as Superintendent of Chonghua Palace protocol procedures, and the emperor thereupon permitted him to go to the Northern Inner Palace; he did not emerge until the sun was setting; the chief councilor led the hundred officials to Chonghua Palace to begin mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the emperor held court; Ruyu entered a memorial as superintendent of Chonghua Palace protocol procedures, and the emperor thereupon permitted him to go to the Northern Inner Palace; he did not emerge until the sun was setting; the chief councilor led the hundred officials to Chonghua Palace to begin mourning.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，將成服，留正與汝愚議，介少傅吳琚請憲聖太后垂簾暫主喪事，憲聖不許。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, when he was about to put on mourning garments, Liu Zheng and Ruyu deliberated; the Junior Tutor Wu Ju through intermediaries requested that the Dowager Empress Xiansheng temporarily draw the curtain and preside over mourning affairs; Xiansheng did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, when he was about to put on mourning garments, Liu Zheng and Ruyu deliberated; Junior Tutor Wu Ju through intermediaries requested that Dowager Empress Xiansheng temporarily draw the curtain and preside over mourning affairs; Xiansheng did not consent.

sentences.zh: 正等附奏曰：「臣等連日造南內請對，不獲。

translations.literal: Zheng and the others submitted a supplementary memorial saying: "We your subjects have for consecutive days gone to the Southern Inner Palace requesting audience and have not been granted it."
translations.idiomatic: Zheng and the others submitted a supplementary memorial: "We your subjects have for consecutive days gone to the Southern Inner Palace requesting audience and have not been granted it."

sentences.zh: 累上疏，不得報。

translations.literal: "We repeatedly submitted memorials and received no reply."
translations.idiomatic: "We have repeatedly submitted memorials and received no reply."

sentences.zh: 今當率百恭官請，若皇帝不出，百官相與慟哭于宮門，恐人情騷動，爲社稷憂。

translations.literal: "Today we ought to lead all the hundred officials in requesting audience; if the emperor does not emerge, the hundred officials will together weep and wail at the palace gate—we fear popular sentiment will be disturbed and become a concern for the altars of state."
translations.idiomatic: "Today we ought to lead all the hundred officials in requesting audience; if the emperor does not emerge, the hundred officials will together weep and wail at the palace gate—we fear popular sentiment will be disturbed and become a concern for the altars of state."

sentences.zh: 乞太皇太后降旨，以皇帝有疾，蹔就宮中成服。

translations.literal: "We beg the Grand Empress Dowager to issue a decree that, because the emperor is ill, he may temporarily complete mourning at the palace."
translations.idiomatic: "We beg the Grand Empress Dowager to issue a decree that, because the emperor is ill, he may temporarily complete mourning at the palace."

sentences.zh: 然喪不可無主，祝文稱『孝子嗣皇帝』，宰臣不敢代行。

translations.literal: "Yet mourning cannot be without a master; in the sacrificial text it says 'the filial son and succeeding emperor'—the chief ministers dare not perform it on his behalf."
translations.idiomatic: "Yet mourning cannot be without a master; the sacrificial text reads 'the filial son and succeeding emperor'—the chief ministers dare not perform it on his behalf."

sentences.zh: 太皇太后，壽皇之母也，請攝行祭禮。

translations.literal: "The Grand Empress Dowager is the mother of Emperor Shouhuang—please act as proxy in performing the sacrificial rites."
translations.idiomatic: "The Grand Empress Dowager is the mother of Emperor Shouhuang—please act as proxy in performing the sacrificial rites."

sentences.zh: 」蓋是時正、汝愚之請垂簾也，以國本係乎嘉王，欲因簾前奏陳宗社之計，使命出簾幃之間，事行廟堂之上，則體正言順，可無後艱。

translations.literal: This was when Zheng and Ruyu were requesting that the curtain be drawn; because the foundation of the state depended on Prince Jia, they wished through statements before the curtain to lay out plans for the altars, so that the mission would emerge from within the curtain and the affair would be carried out atop the ancestral temple—then principle would be correct and words accordant, and there would be no later hardship.
translations.idiomatic: This was when Zheng and Ruyu were requesting that the curtain be drawn; because the foundation of the state depended on Prince Jia, they wished through statements before the curtain to lay out plans for the altars, so that the mission would emerge from within the curtain and the affair would be carried out atop the ancestral temple—then principle would be correct and words accordant, and there would be no later hardship.

sentences.zh: 而吳琚素畏慎，且以后戚不欲與聞大計，此議竟格。

translations.literal: But Wu Ju was by nature always timid and cautious, and moreover as a maternal relative of the empress did not wish to be involved in great plans; this proposal in the end was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: But Wu Ju was by nature timid and cautious, and moreover, as a maternal relative of the empress, did not wish to be involved in great plans; this proposal in the end was blocked.

sentences.zh: 丁未，宰臣已下，待對和寧門，不報，乃入奏云：「皇子嘉王仁孝夙成，宜早正儲位以安人心。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, the chief councilor and below waited for audience at the Heming Gate but received no response; they then entered to memorialize, saying: "The heir Prince Jia is filial and benevolent from early youth—he should early be established as heir apparent to settle popular hearts."
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the chief councilor and below waited for audience at the Heming Gate but received no response; they then entered to memorialize: "Heir Prince Jia is filial and benevolent from early youth—he should early be established as heir apparent to settle popular hearts."

sentences.zh: 」又不報。

translations.literal: Again no response.
translations.idiomatic: Again there was no response.

sentences.zh: 越六日再請，御批云：「甚好。

translations.literal: Six days later they requested again; an imperial annotation read: "Excellent."
translations.idiomatic: Six days later they requested again; an imperial annotation read: "Excellent."

sentences.zh: 」明日，同擬旨以進，乞上親批付學士院降詔。

translations.literal: The next day they jointly drafted the annotation for submission, begging the emperor to annotate it personally and transmit it to the Hanlin Academy to issue a decree.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they jointly drafted the annotation for submission, begging the emperor to annotate it personally and transmit it to the Hanlin Academy to issue a decree.

sentences.zh: 是夕，御批付丞相云：「歷事歲久，念欲退閑。

translations.literal: That evening an imperial annotation was transmitted to the chief councilor saying: "I have served for many years and am minded to retire."
translations.idiomatic: That evening an imperial annotation was transmitted to the chief councilor: "I have served for many years and am minded to retire."

sentences.zh: 」留正見之懼，因朝臨佯仆於庭，密爲去計。

translations.literal: Liu Zheng saw it and was frightened; at the dawn audience he feigned collapse in the courtyard and secretly made plans to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zheng saw it and was frightened; at the dawn audience he feigned collapse in the courtyard and secretly made plans to leave.

sentences.zh: 汝愚自度不得辭其責，念故事須坐甲以戒不虞，而殿帥郭杲莫有以腹心語者。

translations.literal: Ruyu reckoned he could not escape his responsibility; he thought of precedent that one must sit in armor as a precaution against the unexpected, but no one in the Palace Command had spoken confidentially to Guo Gao as a trusted insider.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu reckoned he could not escape his responsibility; he thought of precedent that one must sit in armor as a precaution against the unexpected, but no one in the Palace Command had spoken confidentially to Guo Gao as a trusted insider.

sentences.zh: 會工部尚書趙彥逾至私第，語及國事，汝愚泣，彥逾亦泣，汝愚因微及與子意，彥逾喜。

translations.literal: It happened that the Minister of Works Zhao Yanyu came to his private residence; they spoke of state affairs and Ruyu wept; Yanyu also wept; Ruyu subtly mentioned his intentions regarding the prince, and Yanyu was pleased.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Minister of Works Zhao Yanyu came to his private residence; they spoke of state affairs and Ruyu wept; Yanyu also wept; Ruyu subtly mentioned his intentions regarding the prince, and Yanyu was pleased.

sentences.zh: 汝愚知彥逾善杲，因繆曰：「郭杲儻不同，奈何？

translations.literal: Ruyu knew that Yanyu was on good terms with Guo Gao, and therefore said speciously: "But if Guo Gao should not agree, what then?"
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu knew that Yanyu was on good terms with Guo Gao, and therefore said speciously, "But if Guo Gao should not agree, what then?"

sentences.zh: 」彥逾曰：「某當任之。

translations.literal: Yanyu said: "I shall take responsibility for it."
translations.idiomatic: Yanyu said, "I shall take responsibility for it."

sentences.zh: 」約明乃復命。

translations.literal: They agreed he would report back at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: They agreed he would report back at dawn.

sentences.zh: 汝愚曰：「此大事已出諸口，豈容有所俟乎？

translations.literal: Ruyu said: "This great affair has already passed beyond our lips—how can there be any waiting?"
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu said, "This great affair has already passed beyond our lips—how can there be any waiting?"

sentences.zh: 」汝愚不敢入私室，退坐屏後，以待彥逾之至。

translations.literal: Ruyu dared not enter his private rooms; he withdrew to sit behind the screen, waiting for Yanyu's arrival.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu dared not enter his private rooms; he withdrew to sit behind the screen, waiting for Yanyu's arrival.

sentences.zh: 有頃，彥逾至，議遂定。

translations.literal: Before long Yanyu arrived and the plan was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yanyu arrived and the plan was settled.

sentences.zh: 明日，正以五更肩輿出城去，人心益搖，汝愚處之恬然。

translations.literal: The next day Liu Zheng at the fifth watch left the city in a shoulder-borne litter; popular sentiment grew still more unsettled, but Ruyu remained composed in handling it.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Liu Zheng at the fifth watch left the city in a shoulder-borne litter; popular sentiment grew still more unsettled, but Ruyu remained composed in handling it.

sentences.zh: 自吳琚之議不諧，汝愚與徐誼、葉適謀可以白意于慈福宮者，乃遣韓侂胄以內禪之意請於憲聖。

translations.literal: Since Wu Ju's proposal had not succeeded, Ruyu, together with Xu Yi and Ye Shi, deliberated who could convey their intent to the Cifu Palace, and sent Han Tuozhou to present the plan of inner abdication to Xiansheng.
translations.idiomatic: After Wu Ju's proposal failed, Ruyu deliberated with Xu Yi and Ye Shi on who could convey their intent to the Cifu Palace, and sent Han Tuozhou to present the plan of inner abdication to Dowager Empress Xiansheng.

sentences.zh: 侂胄因所善內侍張宗尹以奏，不獲命，明日往，又不獲命。

translations.literal: Tuozhou, through the inner attendant Zhang Zongyin whom he favored, had it memorialized, but did not obtain approval; he went again the next day and again did not obtain approval.
translations.idiomatic: Through the inner attendant Zhang Zongyin, whom he favored, Tuozhou had it memorialized but received no approval; he went again the next day and again received none.

sentences.zh: 侂胄逡巡將退，重華宮提舉關禮見而問之，侂胄具述汝愚意。

translations.literal: Tuozhou hesitated and was about to withdraw; Guan Li, Superintendent of Protocol at Chonghua Palace, saw him and questioned him, and Tuozhou fully related Ruyu's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou hesitated and was about to withdraw; Guan Li, superintendent of protocol at Chonghua Palace, saw him and questioned him, and Tuozhou fully related Ruyu's intent.

sentences.zh: 禮令少俟，入見憲聖而泣。

translations.literal: Li told him to wait a little, entered to see Xiansheng, and wept.
translations.idiomatic: Li told him to wait briefly, then entered to see Xiansheng and wept.

sentences.zh: 憲聖問故，禮曰：「聖人讀書萬卷，亦嘗見有如此時而保無亂者乎？

translations.literal: Xiansheng asked the reason; Li said: "The sage has read ten thousand scrolls—has he ever seen a time like this and yet been able to guarantee no disorder?"
translations.idiomatic: Xiansheng asked why; Li said, "Your Majesty has read ten thousand scrolls—has Your Majesty ever seen a time like this and yet been able to guarantee there would be no disorder?"

sentences.zh: 」憲聖曰：「此非汝所知。

translations.literal: Xiansheng said: "This is not for you to know."
translations.idiomatic: Xiansheng said, "This is not for you to know."

sentences.zh: 」禮曰：「此事人人知之，今丞相已去，所賴者趙知院，旦夕亦去矣。

translations.literal: Li said: "Everyone knows this matter; now the chief councilor has already gone; what we rely on is Director Zhao—he too will leave before long."
translations.idiomatic: Li said, "Everyone knows this matter; the chief councilor has already gone; what we rely on is Director Zhao—and he too will leave before long."

sentences.zh: 」言與淚俱。

translations.literal: His words and tears came together.
translations.idiomatic: His words came out together with his tears.

sentences.zh: 憲聖驚曰：「知院同姓，事體與他人異，乃亦去乎？

translations.literal: Xiansheng said in alarm: "The director shares our surname; the matter is different from others—yet he too will leave?"
translations.idiomatic: Xiansheng said in alarm, "The director shares our surname; his position differs from others'—yet he too will leave?"

sentences.zh: 」禮曰：「知院未去，非但以同姓故，以太皇太后爲可恃耳。

translations.literal: Li said: "The director has not yet left—not only because we share a surname, but because the Grand Empress Dowager is someone to be relied upon."
translations.idiomatic: Li said, "The director has not yet left—not only because we share a surname, but because the Grand Empress Dowager is someone to be relied upon."

sentences.zh: 今定大計而不獲命，勢不得不去，將如天下何？

translations.literal: Now we have settled a great plan but have not obtained approval; under the circumstances we cannot but leave—what will become of the realm?"
translations.idiomatic: We have settled a great plan but have not obtained approval; under the circumstances we cannot but leave—what will become of the realm?"

sentences.zh: 願聖人三思。

translations.literal: I beg the sage to think thrice.
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to think thrice.

sentences.zh: 」憲聖問侂胄安在，禮曰：「臣已留其俟命。

translations.literal: Xiansheng asked where Tuozhou was; Li said: "Your subject has already detained him awaiting orders."
translations.idiomatic: Xiansheng asked where Tuozhou was; Li said, "Your subject has already detained him awaiting orders."

sentences.zh: 」憲聖曰：「事順則可，令諭好爲之。

translations.literal: Xiansheng said: "If matters go smoothly, that will do; tell him to carry it out well."
translations.idiomatic: Xiansheng said, "If matters go smoothly, that will do; tell him to carry it out well."

sentences.zh: 」禮報侂胄，且云：「來早太皇太后于壽皇梓宮前垂簾引執政。

translations.literal: Li reported to Tuozhou, and also said: "Tomorrow morning the Grand Empress Dowager will draw the curtain before Emperor Shouhuang's coffin and receive the councilors."
translations.idiomatic: Li reported to Tuozhou and also said, "Tomorrow morning the Grand Empress Dowager will draw the curtain before Emperor Shouhuang's coffin and receive the councilors."

sentences.zh: 」侂胄復命，汝愚始以其事語陳騤、余端禮，使郭杲及步帥閻仲夜以兵衛南北內，禮使其姻黨宣贊舍人傅昌朝密制黃袍。

translations.literal: Tuozhou returned to report; Ruyu then told Chen Gui and Yu Duanli of the affair, had Guo Gao and the infantry commander Yan Zhongye garrison the Northern and Southern Inner Palaces with troops, and Li had his affinal relative, Proclamation Attendant Fu Changchao, secretly make the yellow robe.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou returned to report; Ruyu then told Chen Gui and Yu Duanli, had Guo Gao and Infantry Commander Yan Zhongye garrison the Northern and Southern Inner Palaces with troops, and Li had his affinal relative, Proclamation Attendant Fu Changchao, secretly make the yellow robe.

sentences.zh: 是日，嘉王謁告不入臨，汝愚曰：「禫祭重事，王不可不出。

translations.literal: That day Prince Jia requested leave and did not enter mourning attendance; Ruyu said: "The chan sacrifice is a weighty matter—the prince must not fail to appear."
translations.idiomatic: That day Prince Jia requested leave and did not enter mourning attendance; Ruyu said, "The chan sacrifice is a weighty matter—the prince must not fail to appear."

sentences.zh: 」翌日，禫祭，群臣入，王亦入。

translations.literal: The next day was the chan sacrifice; the ministers entered, and the prince also entered.
translations.idiomatic: The next day came the chan sacrifice; the ministers entered, and the prince also entered.

sentences.zh: 汝愚率百官詣大行前，憲聖垂簾，汝愚率同列再拜，奏：「皇帝疾，未能執喪，臣等乞立皇子嘉王爲太子，以繫人心。

translations.literal: Ruyu led the hundred officials before the late emperor's coffin; Xiansheng drew the curtain; Ruyu led his colleagues in bowing again and memorialized: "The emperor is ill and unable to perform mourning; we your subjects beg to establish Prince Jia as heir apparent to bind popular hearts."
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu led the hundred officials before the late emperor's coffin; Xiansheng drew the curtain; Ruyu led his colleagues in bowing again and memorialized, "The emperor is ill and unable to perform mourning; we your subjects beg to establish Prince Jia as heir apparent to bind popular hearts."

sentences.zh: 皇帝批出有『甚好』二字，繼有『念欲退閑』之語，取太皇太后處分。

translations.literal: The emperor's annotation had the two characters 'excellent,' followed by words 'minded to retire'; we seek the Grand Empress Dowager's disposition.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's annotation had the two characters 'excellent,' followed by words 'minded to retire'; we seek the Grand Empress Dowager's disposition.

sentences.zh: 」憲聖曰：「既有御筆，相公當奉行。

translations.literal: Xiansheng said: "Since there is an imperial hand, the chief councilor ought to carry it out."
translations.idiomatic: Xiansheng said, "Since there is an imperial hand, the chief councilor ought to carry it out."

sentences.zh: 」汝愚曰：「茲事重大，播之天下，書之史冊，須議一指揮。

translations.literal: Ruyu said: "This matter is weighty; broadcast to the realm and written in the historical records—it requires deliberating a directive."
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu said, "This matter is weighty; broadcast to the realm and written in the historical records—it requires deliberating a directive."

sentences.zh: 」憲聖允諾。

translations.literal: Xiansheng consented.
translations.idiomatic: Xiansheng consented.

sentences.zh: 汝愚袖出所擬太皇太后指揮以進，云：「皇帝以疾至今未能執喪，曾有御筆，欲自退閑。

translations.literal: Ruyu drew from his sleeve the draft directive of the Grand Empress Dowager and presented it, saying: "The emperor, because of illness, has to this day been unable to perform mourning; he once had an imperial hand wishing to retire of his own accord."
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu drew from his sleeve the draft directive of the Grand Empress Dowager and presented it, saying, "The emperor, because of illness, has to this day been unable to perform mourning; he once had an imperial hand wishing to retire of his own accord."

sentences.zh: 皇子嘉王擴可即皇帝位，尊皇帝爲太上皇帝，皇后爲太上皇后。

translations.literal: Prince Jia Kuo may immediately take the imperial throne; honor the emperor as Retired Emperor and the empress as Retired Empress.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jia Kuo may immediately take the imperial throne; honor the emperor as Retired Emperor and the empress as Retired Empress.

sentences.zh: 」憲聖覽畢曰：「甚善。

translations.literal: When Xiansheng had finished reading she said: "Excellent."
translations.idiomatic: When Xiansheng had finished reading she said, "Excellent."

sentences.zh: 」汝愚奏：「自今臣等有合奏事，當取嗣君處分。

translations.literal: Ruyu memorialized: "From now on, when we your subjects have matters requiring memorial, we ought to seek the disposition of the succeeding ruler."
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu memorialized, "From now on, when we your subjects have matters requiring memorial, we ought to seek the disposition of the succeeding ruler."

sentences.zh: 然恐兩宮父子間有難處者，須煩太皇太后主張。

translations.literal: Yet we fear there may be difficult points between the two palaces, father and son—it will be necessary to trouble the Grand Empress Dowager to take charge.
translations.idiomatic: Yet we fear there may be difficult points between the two palaces, father and son—it will be necessary to trouble the Grand Empress Dowager to take charge.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「上皇疾未平，驟聞此事，不無驚疑，乞令都知楊舜卿提舉本宮，任其責。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "The Retired Emperor's illness is not yet settled; hearing this matter suddenly, he cannot be without alarm and doubt—we beg that Director Yang Shunqing be appointed superintendent of his palace and bear the responsibility."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized, "The Retired Emperor's illness is not yet settled; hearing this matter suddenly, he cannot be without alarm and doubt—we beg that Director Yang Shunqing be appointed superintendent of his palace and bear the responsibility."

sentences.zh: 」遂召舜卿至簾前，面喻之。

translations.literal: Shunqing was thereupon summoned before the curtain and instructed face to face.
translations.idiomatic: Shunqing was thereupon summoned before the curtain and instructed face to face.

sentences.zh: 憲聖乃命皇子即位，皇子固辭曰：「恐負不孝名。

translations.literal: Xiansheng then ordered the prince to take the throne; the prince firmly declined, saying: "I fear bearing the name of unfilial conduct."
translations.idiomatic: Xiansheng then ordered the prince to take the throne; the prince firmly declined, saying, "I fear bearing the name of unfilial conduct."

sentences.zh: 」汝愚奏：「天子當以安社稷、定國家爲孝。

translations.literal: Ruyu memorialized: "The Son of Heaven ought to take securing the altars and settling the state as filial piety."
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu memorialized, "The Son of Heaven ought to take securing the altars and settling the state as filial piety."

sentences.zh: 今中外人人憂亂，萬一變生，置太上皇何地？

translations.literal: Now within and without, everyone is anxious about disorder; if by chance a change arises, where will the Retired Emperor be placed?"
translations.idiomatic: Now within and without, everyone is anxious about disorder; if by chance a change arises, where will the Retired Emperor be placed?"

sentences.zh: 」衆扶入素幄，披黃袍，方卻立未坐，汝愚率同列再拜。

translations.literal: The crowd helped him into the plain canopy, draped the yellow robe over him; he had just stepped back and not yet sat down when Ruyu led his colleagues in bowing again.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd helped him into the plain canopy and draped the yellow robe over him; he had just stepped back and not yet sat down when Ruyu led his colleagues in bowing again.

sentences.zh: 寧宗詣几筵殿，哭盡哀。

translations.literal: Ningzong went to the Hall of the Spirit Tablet and wept to the full measure of grief.
translations.idiomatic: Ningzong went to the Hall of the Spirit Tablet and wept to the full measure of grief.

sentences.zh: 須臾，立仗訖，催百官班。

translations.literal: Before long the guard formation was complete and the hundred officials' ranks were urged forward.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the guard formation was complete and the hundred officials' ranks were urged forward.

sentences.zh: 帝衰服出就重華殿東廡素幄立，內侍扶掖乃坐。

translations.literal: The emperor in mourning dress came out and took his place standing in the plain canopy in the eastern gallery of Chonghua Palace; only with inner attendants supporting him on both sides did he sit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in mourning dress came out and took his place standing in the plain canopy in the eastern gallery of Chonghua Palace; only with inner attendants supporting him on both sides did he sit.

sentences.zh: 百官起居訖，行禫祭禮。

translations.literal: When the hundred officials had finished paying their respects, the chan sacrifice rites were performed.
translations.idiomatic: When the hundred officials had finished paying their respects, the chan sacrifice rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 汝愚即喪次，召還留正長百僚，命朱熹待制經筵，悉收召士君子之在外者。

translations.literal: Ruyu, still at the mourning site, summoned Liu Zheng back to head the hundred officials, appointed Zhu Xi as academician on the Classics Mat, and fully recalled gentlemen of worth who were outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu, still at the mourning site, summoned Liu Zheng back to head the hundred officials, appointed Zhu Xi as academician on the Classics Mat, and fully recalled gentlemen of worth who were outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 侍御史張叔椿請議正棄國之罰，汝愚爲遷叔椿官。

translations.literal: The Attendant Censor Zhang Shuchun requested deliberation on punishing the crime of abandoning the state; Ruyu had Shuchun's office changed in promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Censor Zhang Shuchun requested deliberation on punishing the crime of abandoning the state; Ruyu had Shuchun's office changed in promotion.

sentences.zh: 是月，上命汝愚兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: That month the emperor ordered Ruyu to concurrently serve as Acting Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: That month the emperor ordered Ruyu to concurrently serve as acting vice councilor.

sentences.zh: 留正至，汝愚乞免兼職，乃除特進、右丞相。

translations.literal: When Liu Zheng arrived, Ruyu begged to be relieved of the concurrent post and was then made Special Advanced and Right Chief Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Zheng arrived, Ruyu begged to be relieved of the concurrent post and was then made Special Advanced and right chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 汝愚辭不拜，曰：「同姓之卿，不幸處君臣之變，敢言功乎？

translations.literal: Ruyu declined and did not bow to accept, saying: "A minister of the same surname, unhappily placed in the change between ruler and subject—how dare I speak of merit?"
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu declined and did not bow to accept, saying, "A minister of the same surname, unhappily placed in the change between ruler and subject—how dare I speak of merit?"

sentences.zh: 」乃命以特進爲樞密使，汝愚又辭特進。

translations.literal: He was then ordered to serve as Military Affairs Commissioner with the rank of Special Advanced; Ruyu again declined the Special Advanced rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was then ordered to serve as military affairs commissioner with the rank of Special Advanced; Ruyu again declined the Special Advanced rank.

sentences.zh: 孝宗將攢，汝愚議攢宮非永制，欲改卜山陵，與留正議不合。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong was about to be placed in the temporary palace vault, Ruyu argued that the vault palace was not a permanent institution and wished to change the site selection for the mountain tomb; he disagreed with Liu Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong was about to be placed in the temporary palace vault, Ruyu argued that the vault palace was not a permanent institution and wished to change the site selection for the mountain tomb; he disagreed with Liu Zheng.

sentences.zh: 侂胄因而間之，出正判建康，命汝愚爲光祿大夫、右丞相。

translations.literal: Tuozhou thereupon sowed discord between them, sent Zheng out as prefect of Jiankang, and appointed Ruyu Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and right chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou thereupon sowed discord between them, sent Zheng out as prefect of Jiankang, and appointed Ruyu Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and right chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 汝愚力辭至再三，不許。

translations.literal: Ruyu strenuously declined again and again; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu strenuously declined again and again; it was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 汝愚本倚正共事，怒侂胄不以告，及來謁，故不見，侂胄慚忿。

translations.literal: Ruyu had originally relied on Zheng to work together; he was angry that Tuozhou had not informed him, and when Tuozhou came to call, deliberately did not see him; Tuozhou was ashamed and resentful.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu had originally relied on Zheng to work together; he was angry that Tuozhou had not informed him, and when Tuozhou came to call, deliberately did not see him; Tuozhou was ashamed and resentful.

sentences.zh: 簽書樞密羅點曰：「公誤矣。

translations.literal: The Acting Military Affairs Commissioner Luo Dian said: "My lord, you are mistaken."
translations.idiomatic: Acting Military Affairs Commissioner Luo Dian said, "My lord, you are mistaken."

sentences.zh: 」汝愚亦悟，復見之。

translations.literal: Ruyu also came to understand and received him again.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu also came to understand and received him again.

sentences.zh: 侂胄終不懌，自以有定策功，且依託肺腑，出入宮掖，居中用事。

translations.literal: Tuozhou in the end was not pleased; he considered himself to have merit in settling the plan, and moreover relied on being a close relative by marriage, going in and out of the palace women's quarters and wielding power at the center.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou in the end was not pleased; he considered himself to have merit in settling the plan, and moreover relied on being a close relative by marriage, going in and out of the palace women's quarters and wielding power at the center.

sentences.zh: 朱熹進對，以爲言，又約吏部侍郎彭龜年同劾之，未果。

translations.literal: Zhu Xi entered audience and spoke on this; he also arranged with Vice Minister of Personnel Peng Guinian to impeach him together, but it did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xi entered audience and spoke on this; he also arranged with Vice Minister of Personnel Peng Guinian to impeach him together, but it did not succeed.

sentences.zh: 熹白汝愚，當以厚賞酬勞，勿使預政，而汝愚謂其易制不爲慮。

translations.literal: Xi told Ruyu he ought to reward him with generous gifts and not let him participate in government, but Ruyu considered him easy to control and did not take it into account.
translations.idiomatic: Xi told Ruyu he ought to reward him with generous gifts and not let him participate in government, but Ruyu considered him easy to control and did not take it into account.

sentences.zh: 侂胄恃功，爲汝愚所抑，日夜謀引其黨爲臺諫，以擯汝愚。

translations.literal: Relying on his merit, Tuozhou was restrained by Ruyu and day and night plotted to bring in his faction as censors and remonstrators to drive Ruyu out.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on his merit, Tuozhou was restrained by Ruyu and day and night plotted to bring in his faction as censors and remonstrators to drive Ruyu out.

sentences.zh: 汝愚爲人疏，不虞其姦。

translations.literal: Ruyu by nature was careless and did not guard against his treachery.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu by nature was careless and did not guard against his treachery.

sentences.zh: 趙彥逾以嘗達意于郭杲，事定，冀汝愚引與同列，至是除四川制置，意不愜，與侂胄合謀。

translations.literal: Zhao Yanyu, because he had once conveyed intent to Guo Gao, when the affair was settled expected Ruyu to bring him into the same rank; now he was made Sichuan Commissioner and was discontented, and joined in plotting with Tuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanyu, because he had once conveyed intent to Guo Gao, when the affair was settled expected Ruyu to bring him into the same rank; now he was made Sichuan commissioner and was discontented, and joined in plotting with Tuozhou.

sentences.zh: 陛辭日，盡疏當時賢者姓名，指爲汝愚之黨，上意不能無疑。

translations.literal: On the day of his audience on departure he fully listed the names of worthy men of the time, pointing to them as Ruyu's faction; the emperor's mind could not be without doubt.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of his audience on departure he fully listed the names of worthy men of the time, pointing to them as Ruyu's faction; the emperor's mind could not be without doubt.

sentences.zh: 汝愚請令近臣舉御史，侂胄密諭中司，令薦所厚大理寺簿劉德秀，內批擢德秀爲察官，其黨牽聯以進，言路遂皆侂胄之人。

translations.literal: Ruyu requested that close ministers recommend censors; Tuozhou secretly instructed the Central Office to recommend his own favorite, Registrar of the Court of Judicial Review Liu Dexiu; an inner annotation promoted Dexiu as investigating officer; his faction advanced in linked succession, and the remonstrance path was thus all Tuozhou's men.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu requested that close ministers recommend censors; Tuozhou secretly instructed the Central Office to recommend his own favorite, Registrar of the Court of Judicial Review Liu Dexiu; an inner annotation promoted Dexiu as investigating officer; his faction advanced in linked succession, and the remonstrance path was thus all Tuozhou's men.

sentences.zh: 會黃裳、羅點卒，侂胄又擢其黨京鏜代點，汝愚始孤，天子益無所倚信。

translations.literal: When Huang Shang and Luo Dian died, Tuozhou again promoted his faction member Jing Yong to replace Dian; Ruyu was then isolated, and the Son of Heaven increasingly had no one to rely on and trust.
translations.idiomatic: When Huang Shang and Luo Dian died, Tuozhou again promoted his faction member Jing Yong to replace Dian; Ruyu was then isolated, and the Son of Heaven increasingly had no one to rely on and trust.

sentences.zh: 於是中書舍人陳傅良、監察御史吳獵、起居郎劉光祖各先後斥去，群憸和附，疾正士如仇讎，而衣冠之禍始矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon Secretariat Drafter Chen Fuliang, Investigating Censor Wu Lie, and Attendant of the Left Liu Guangzu were each in turn driven out; the crowd of flatterers joined in support, hating upright gentlemen like mortal enemies—and the calamity of the scholar-official class began.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Secretariat Drafter Chen Fuliang, Investigating Censor Wu Lie, and Attendant of the Left Liu Guangzu were each in turn driven out; the crowd of flatterers joined in support, hating upright gentlemen like mortal enemies—and the calamity of the scholar-official class began.

sentences.zh: 侂胄欲逐汝愚而難其名，或教之曰：「彼宗姓，誣以謀危社稷，則一網無遺。

translations.literal: Tuozhou wished to drive Ruyu out but found it hard to name a charge; someone advised him: "He is of the imperial clan—falsely accuse him of plotting to endanger the altars, and then not one will escape the net."
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou wished to drive Ruyu out but found it hard to name a charge; someone advised him, "He is of the imperial clan—falsely accuse him of plotting to endanger the altars, and then not one will escape the net."

sentences.zh: 」侂胄然之，擢其黨將作監李沐爲正言。

translations.literal: Tuozhou thought this right and promoted his faction member Li Mu of the Directorate of Palace Construction to Chief Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou thought this right and promoted his faction member Li Mu of the Directorate of Palace Construction to chief remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 沐，彥穎之子也，嘗求節度使于汝愚不得，奏：「汝愚以同姓居相位，將不利於社稷，乞罷其政。

translations.literal: Mu, son of Yan Ying, had once requested a military commissioner post from Ruyu and not obtained it; he memorialized: "Ruyu, because he shares a surname, holds the chancellorship and will be harmful to the altars—we beg that his government be ended."
translations.idiomatic: Mu, son of Yan Ying, had once requested a military commissioner post from Ruyu and not obtained it; he memorialized, "Ruyu, because he shares a surname, holds the chancellorship and will be harmful to the altars—we beg that his government be ended."

sentences.zh: 」汝愚出浙江亭待罪，遂罷右相，除觀文殿學士、知福州。

translations.literal: Ruyu went out to the Zhejiang Pavilion to await punishment; he was then dismissed as right chief councilor and made Academician at the Hall for Viewing Literature and prefect of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu went out to the Zhejiang Pavilion to await punishment; he was then dismissed as right chief councilor and made academician at the Hall for Viewing Literature and prefect of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 臺臣合詞乞寢出守之命，遂以大學士提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: The censors together petitioned to suspend the order sending him out to guard a prefecture; he was then made Grand Academician and Superintendent of the Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The censors together petitioned to suspend the order sending him out to guard a prefecture; he was then made grand academician and superintendent of the Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 國子祭酒李祥言：「去歲國遭大戚，中外洶洶，留正棄相位而去，官僚幾欲解散，軍民皆將爲亂，兩宮隔絕，國喪無主。

translations.literal: Director of the Directorate of Education Li Xiang said: "Last year the state suffered great grief; within and without there was uproar; Liu Zheng abandoned the chancellorship and left; the bureaucracy nearly dissolved; soldiers and civilians were all about to riot; the two palaces were cut off from each other; the state mourning had no master."
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Directorate of Education Li Xiang said, "Last year the state suffered great grief; within and without there was uproar; Liu Zheng abandoned the chancellorship and left; the bureaucracy nearly dissolved; soldiers and civilians were all about to riot; the two palaces were cut off from each other; the state mourning had no master."

sentences.zh: 汝愚以樞臣獨不避殞身滅族之禍，奉太皇太后命，翊陛下以登九五，勳勞著於社稷，精忠貫於天地，乃卒受黯黮而去，天下後世其謂何？

translations.literal: Ruyu alone, as military affairs minister, did not avoid the peril of losing his body and exterminating his clan; obeying the Grand Empress Dowager's command, he assisted Your Majesty to ascend the throne; his merit was manifest on the altars, his pure loyalty penetrated heaven and earth—yet in the end he received obscurity and dismissal; what will the realm and posterity say?"
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu alone, as military affairs minister, did not avoid the peril of losing his body and exterminating his clan; obeying the Grand Empress Dowager's command, he assisted Your Majesty to ascend the throne; his merit was manifest on the altars, his pure loyalty penetrated heaven and earth—yet in the end he received obscurity and dismissal; what will the realm and posterity say?"

sentences.zh: 」博士楊簡亦以爲言。

translations.literal: Doctor Yang Jian also spoke likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Doctor Yang Jian also spoke likewise.

sentences.zh: 李沐劾祥、簡，罷之。

translations.literal: Li Mu impeached Xiang and Jian and had them dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mu impeached Xiang and Jian and had them dismissed.

sentences.zh: 太府丞呂祖儉亦上書訴汝愚之忠，詔祖儉朋比罔上，送韶州安置。

translations.literal: Assistant Director of the Palace Storehouse Lü Zujian also submitted a memorial appealing for Ruyu's loyalty; an edict said Zujian had formed factions to deceive the throne and sent him to Sha Prefecture for resettlement.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Director of the Palace Storehouse Lü Zujian also submitted a memorial appealing for Ruyu's loyalty; an edict said Zujian had formed factions to deceive the throne and sent him to Sha Prefecture for resettlement.

sentences.zh: 太學生楊宏中、周端朝、張衜、林仲麟、蔣傅、徐範等伏闕言：「去歲人情驚疑，變在朝夕。

translations.literal: Imperial University students Yang Hongzhong, Zhou Duanchao, Zhang Heng, Lin Zhonglin, Jiang Fu, Xu Fan, and others knelt at the palace gate and said: "Last year popular sentiment was alarmed and doubtful; change was imminent from morning to evening."
translations.idiomatic: Imperial University students Yang Hongzhong, Zhou Duanchao, Zhang Heng, Lin Zhonglin, Jiang Fu, Xu Fan, and others knelt at the palace gate and said, "Last year popular sentiment was alarmed and doubtful; change was imminent from morning to evening."

sentences.zh: 當時假非汝愚出死力，定大議，雖百李沐，罔知攸濟。

translations.literal: At that time, if Ruyu had not exerted himself to the death to settle the great decision, even a hundred Li Mu could not have known how to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, if Ruyu had not exerted himself to the death to settle the great decision, even a hundred Li Mu could not have known how to succeed.

sentences.zh: 當國家多難，汝愚位樞府，本兵柄，指揮操縱，何向不可，不以此時爲利，今上下安恬，乃獨有異志乎？

translations.literal: When the state was in many difficulties, Ruyu held the Military Commission and controlled military power—commanding and manipulating, what direction could he not take? He did not seek profit at that time; now above and below are tranquil—does he alone harbor a different intent?"
translations.idiomatic: When the state was in many difficulties, Ruyu held the Military Commission and controlled military power—commanding and manipulating, what direction could he not take? He did not seek profit at that time; now above and below are tranquil—does he alone harbor a different intent?"

sentences.zh: 」書上，悉送五百里外羈管。

translations.literal: When the memorial went up, all were sent for supervised resettlement five hundred li beyond.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial went up, all were sent for supervised resettlement five hundred li beyond.

sentences.zh: 汝愚學務有用，常以司馬光、富弼、韓琦、范仲淹自期。

translations.literal: Ruyu in learning pursued practical use and often took Sima Guang, Fu Bi, Han Qi, and Fan Zhongyan as his models.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu in learning pursued practical use and often took Sima Guang, Fu Bi, Han Qi, and Fan Zhongyan as his models.

sentences.zh: 凡平昔所聞于師友，如張栻、朱熹、呂祖謙、汪應辰、王十朋、胡銓、李燾、林光朝之言，欲次第行之，未果。

translations.literal: Whatever he had heard in the past from teachers and friends—such as the words of Zhang Shi, Zhu Xi, Lü Zuqian, Wang Yingchen, Wang Shipeng, Hu Quan, Li Tao, and Lin Guangchao—he wished to carry out in sequence but did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever he had heard in the past from teachers and friends—such as the words of Zhang Shi, Zhu Xi, Lü Zuqian, Wang Yingchen, Wang Shipeng, Hu Quan, Li Tao, and Lin Guangchao—he wished to carry out in sequence but did not succeed.

sentences.zh: 所著詩文十五卷、《太祖實錄舉要》若干卷、《類宋朝諸臣奏議》三百卷。

translations.literal: His writings included fifteen juan of poetry and prose, several juan of Essentials from the Veritable Records of Taizu, and three hundred juan of Classified Memorials and Proposals of Song Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: His writings included fifteen juan of poetry and prose, several juan of Essentials from the Veritable Records of Taizu, and three hundred juan of Classified Memorials and Proposals of Song Ministers.

sentences.zh: 汝愚聚族而居，門內三千指，所得廩給悉分與之，菜羹疏食，恩意均洽，人無間言。

translations.literal: Ruyu gathered his clan to live together; within the gate were three thousand persons; whatever salary he received he fully distributed to them; with vegetable broth and coarse food, kindness and favor were equally extended, and no one spoke against it.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu gathered his clan to live together; within the gate were three thousand persons; whatever salary he received he fully distributed to them; with vegetable broth and coarse food, kindness and favor were equally extended, and no one spoke against it.

sentences.zh: 自奉養甚薄，爲夕郎時，大冬衣布裘，至爲相亦然。

translations.literal: His own support was very meager; when he was Attendant of the Left, in deep winter he wore cloth and fur; when he became chancellor it was still the same.
translations.idiomatic: His own support was very meager; when he was Attendant of the Left, in deep winter he wore cloth and fur; when he became chancellor it was still the same.

sentences.zh: 汝愚既歿，黨禁寖解，旋復資政殿學士、太中大夫，已而贈少保。

translations.literal: After Ruyu died, the faction ban gradually eased; he was soon restored as Academician at the Hall of Assisting Governance and Grand Master of the Palace; later he was posthumously made Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: After Ruyu died, the faction ban gradually eased; he was soon restored as academician at the Hall of Assisting Governance and Grand Master of the Palace; later he was posthumously made Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 侂胄誅，盡復元官，賜諡「忠定」，贈太師，追封沂國公。

translations.literal: When Tuozhou was executed, all his former offices were fully restored; he was given the posthumous title "Loyal and Settled," posthumously made Grand Preceptor, and enfeoffed as Duke of Yi State.
translations.idiomatic: When Tuozhou was executed, all his former offices were fully restored; he was given the posthumous title "Loyal and Settled," posthumously made Grand Preceptor, and enfeoffed as Duke of Yi State.

sentences.zh: 理宗詔配享寧宗廟庭，追封福王，其後進封周王。

translations.literal: Emperor Lizong decreed that he be granted joint sacrifice in Ningzong's temple hall, enfeoffed as Prince of Fu, and later advanced to Prince of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Lizong decreed that he be granted joint sacrifice in Ningzong's temple hall, enfeoffed as Prince of Fu, and later advanced to Prince of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 子九人，崇憲，其長子也。

translations.literal: He had nine sons; Chongxian was his eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: He had nine sons; Chongxian was his eldest son.

sentences.zh: 子 崇憲

translations.literal: Son: Chongxian
translations.idiomatic: Son: Chongxian

sentences.zh: 崇憲，字履常，淳熙八年以取應對策第一，時汝愚侍立殿上，降，再拜以謝。

translations.literal: Chongxian, style name Lüchang, in the eighth year of Chunxi ranked first in the examination for special response; at the time Ruyu was attending in the hall above; when he descended he bowed twice to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxian, style name Lüchang, in the eighth year of Chunxi ranked first in the examination for special response; at the time Ruyu was attending in the hall above; when he descended he bowed twice to give thanks.

sentences.zh: 孝宗顧近臣曰：「汝愚年幾何？

translations.literal: Xiaozong turned to the close ministers and said: "How old is Ruyu?"
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozong turned to the close ministers and said, "How old is Ruyu?"

sentences.zh: 已有子如此。

translations.literal: He already has a son like this.
translations.idiomatic: He already has a son like this.

sentences.zh: 」越三年，復以進士對策，擢甲科。

translations.literal: Three years later he again answered the jinshi policy questions and was placed in the top grade.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later he again answered the jinshi policy questions and was placed in the top grade.

sentences.zh: 上謂執政曰：「此汝愚子，豈即前科取應第一人者耶？」

translations.literal: The emperor said to the councilors: "This is Ruyu's son—is he not the one who ranked first in the special response examination of the previous session?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to the councilors, "This is Ruyu's son—is he not the one who ranked first in the special response examination of the previous session?"

sentences.zh: 崇憲初仕爲保義郎、監饒州贍軍酒庫，換從事郎、撫州軍事推官。

translations.literal: Chongxian's first offices were Baoyi Lang and Superintendent of the Raozhou Provisioning Army Wine Depot; he exchanged to Assistant and Military Judge of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxian's first offices were Baoyi Lang and superintendent of the Raozhou Provisioning Army Wine Depot; he exchanged to assistant and military judge of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 汝愚帥蜀，辟書寫機宜文字，改江西轉運司幹辦公事，監西京中嶽廟。

translations.literal: When Ruyu commanded Sichuan, he was recruited as drafter of confidential documents; he was changed to Jiangxi Transport Commission staff officer and Superintendent of the Central Peak Temple of the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Ruyu commanded Sichuan, he was recruited as drafter of confidential documents; he was changed to Jiangxi transport commission staff officer and superintendent of the Central Peak Temple of the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 汝愚既貶死，海內憤鬱，崇憲闔門自處。

translations.literal: After Ruyu was demoted and died, indignation spread throughout the realm; Chongxian shut his doors and kept to himself.
translations.idiomatic: After Ruyu was demoted and died, indignation spread throughout the realm; Chongxian shut his doors and kept to himself.

sentences.zh: 居數年，復汝愚故官職，多勸以仕。

translations.literal: After several years Ruyu's former offices were restored; many urged him to take office.
translations.idiomatic: After several years Ruyu's former offices were restored; many urged him to take office.

sentences.zh: 改奉議郎、知南昌縣事，奉行荒政，所活甚衆。

translations.literal: He was changed to Presentation Discussant and Prefect of Nanchang County; he carried out famine relief policy and saved very many lives.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to Presentation Discussant and prefect of Nanchang County; he carried out famine relief policy and saved very many lives.

sentences.zh: 升籍田令，制曰：「爾先人有功王室，中更讒毀，思其功而錄其子，國之典也。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Director of the Imperial Fields; the edict said: "Your forebear had merit for the royal house; midway he suffered slander and ruin; thinking of his merit, his son is recorded—this is the state's canon."
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Director of the Imperial Fields; the edict said, "Your forebear had merit for the royal house; midway he suffered slander and ruin; thinking of his merit, his son is recorded—this is the state's canon."

sentences.zh: 」崇憲拜命感泣，陳疏力辭，以爲「先臣之冤未悉昭白，而其孤先被寵光，非公朝所以勸忠孝、厲廉恥之意」。

translations.literal: Chongxian received the appointment with moved weeping, submitted a memorial strenuously declining, holding that "my late father's injustice has not yet been fully cleared, yet his orphan is first granted favor and glory—this is not what the public court means by encouraging loyalty and filial piety and sharpening integrity and shame."
translations.idiomatic: Chongxian received the appointment with moved weeping, submitted a memorial strenuously declining, holding that "my late father's injustice has not yet been fully cleared, yet his orphan is first granted favor and glory—this is not what the public court means by encouraging loyalty and filial piety and sharpening integrity and shame."

sentences.zh: 俄改監行在都進奏院，復引陳瓘論司馬光、呂公著復官事申言之，乞以所陳下三省集議：「若先臣心跡有一如言者所論，即近日恩典皆爲冒濫，先臣復官賜諡，與臣新命，俱合追寢。

translations.literal: Soon he was changed to Superintendent of the Capital Memorial Submission Office; he again cited Chen Guan's discussion of restoring the offices of Sima Guang and Lü Gongzhu and elaborated on it, begging that what he had stated be sent down to the Three Departments for collective deliberation: "If my late father's conduct in heart and deed had any part like what the speakers alleged, then the recent favors are all presumptuous excess; my late father's restoration of office and grant of posthumous title, together with my new appointment, ought all to be revoked."
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was changed to superintendent of the Capital Memorial Submission Office; he again cited Chen Guan's discussion of restoring the offices of Sima Guang and Lü Gongzhu and elaborated on it, begging that what he had stated be sent down to the Three Departments for collective deliberation: "If my late father's conduct in heart and deed had any part like what the speakers alleged, then the recent favors are all presumptuous excess; my late father's restoration of office and grant of posthumous title, together with my new appointment, ought all to be revoked."

sentences.zh: 如公論果謂誣衊，乞昭示中外，使先臣之讒謗既辨，忠節自明，而憲聖慈烈皇后擁佑之功德益顯。

translations.literal: If public opinion truly holds it was slander and defamation, I beg that it be made manifest within and without, so that my late father's slander is already distinguished, his loyal integrity is self-evident, and the merit of Empress Dowager Xiansheng, the Kind and Stern, in supporting and protecting is still more manifest.
