translations.idiomatic: If public opinion truly holds it was slander and defamation, I beg that it be made manifest within and without, so that my late father's slander is already distinguished, his loyal integrity is self-evident, and the merit of Empress Dowager Xiansheng, the Kind and Stern, in supporting and protecting is still more manifest.

sentences.zh: 然後申飭史官、改正誣史，垂萬世之公。」

translations.literal: Only then instruct the historiographers to correct the false history and leave fairness for ten thousand generations."
translations.idiomatic: Only then instruct the historiographers to correct the false history and leave fairness for ten thousand generations."

sentences.zh: 又請正趙師召妄貢封章之罪，究蔡璉與大臣爲仇之姦，毀龔頤正《續稽古錄》之妄。

translations.literal: He also requested rectifying the crime of Zhao Shizhao's reckless submission of sealed memorials, investigating the treachery of Cai Lian's enmity toward great ministers, and refuting the falsehood of Gong Yizheng's Continued Records for Examining Antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested rectifying the crime of Zhao Shizhao's reckless submission of sealed memorials, investigating the treachery of Cai Lian's enmity toward great ministers, and refuting the falsehood of Gong Yizheng's Continued Records for Examining Antiquity.

sentences.zh: 詔兩省史官考訂以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the historiographers of the Two Departments to examine and fix the matter and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the historiographers of the Two Departments to examine and fix the matter and report.

sentences.zh: 已而吏部尚書兼修國史樓鑰等請施行如章，從之。

translations.literal: Before long the Minister of Personnel and Concurrent Compiler of National History Lou Yue and others requested implementation as in the memorial; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Minister of Personnel and concurrent compiler of national history Lou Yue and others requested implementation as in the memorial; it was approved.

sentences.zh: 及誣史未正，復進言，其略謂：「前日史官徒以權臣風旨，刊舊史、焚元稿，略無留難。

translations.literal: When the false history had still not been corrected, he memorialized again, in summary saying: "Previously the historiographers merely followed the powerful minister's intent, revised the old history, burned the original drafts, and scarcely hesitated at all."
translations.idiomatic: When the false history had still not been corrected, he memorialized again, in summary saying, "Previously the historiographers merely followed the powerful minister's intent, revised the old history, burned the original drafts, and scarcely hesitated at all."

sentences.zh: 今詔旨再三，莫有慨然奮直筆者，何小人敢於爲惡，而謂之君子者顧不能勇於爲善耶？

translations.literal: Now the edict has been repeated again and again, yet no one boldly wields the straight brush—why do petty men dare to do evil, while those called gentlemen cannot boldly do good?"
translations.idiomatic: Now the edict has been repeated again and again, yet no one boldly wields the straight brush—why do petty men dare to do evil, while those called gentlemen cannot boldly do good?"

sentences.zh: 」聞者愧之。

translations.literal: Those who heard it felt ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: Those who heard it felt ashamed.

sentences.zh: 其後玉牒、日曆所卒以《重修龍飛事實》進呈，因崇憲請也。

translations.literal: Afterward the Imperial Genealogy and Calendar Office finally presented the Revised Record of the Dragon's Ascension as a memorial—this was at Chongxian's request.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the Imperial Genealogy and Calendar Office finally presented the Revised Record of the Dragon's Ascension as a memorial—this was at Chongxian's request.

sentences.zh: 未幾，贈汝愚太師，封沂國公，擢崇憲軍器監丞，改太府監丞，遷祕書郎，辭，弗許。

translations.literal: Before long Ruyu was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Duke of Yi State; Chongxian was promoted to Assistant Director of the Directorate of Armaments, changed to Assistant Director of the Palace Storehouse, promoted to Secretary, declined, and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Ruyu was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Duke of Yi State; Chongxian was promoted to assistant director of the Directorate of Armaments, changed to assistant director of the Palace Storehouse, promoted to secretary, declined, and was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 尋爲著作佐郎兼權考功郎官。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Assistant Compiler and Acting Director in the Ministry of Personnel's Examination Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made assistant compiler and acting director in the Ministry of Personnel's Examination Bureau.

sentences.zh: 嘗因閔雨求言，乃上封事，謂：「今日有更化之名，無更化之實。

translations.literal: When rain was sought amid drought and opinions were invited, he submitted a sealed memorial, saying: "Today there is the name of renewal but not the reality of renewal."
translations.idiomatic: When rain was sought amid drought and opinions were invited, he submitted a sealed memorial, saying, "Today there is the name of renewal but not the reality of renewal."

sentences.zh: 人才，國之元氣，而忠鯁擯廢之士，死者未盡省錄，存者未悉褒揚。

translations.literal: Talent is the state's vital energy, yet loyal and outspoken scholars who were driven out—the dead have not all been recalled and recorded, the living have not all been praised and promoted.
translations.idiomatic: Talent is the state's vital energy, yet loyal and outspoken scholars who were driven out—the dead have not all been recalled and recorded, the living have not all been praised and promoted.

sentences.zh: 言論，國之風采，其間輸忠亡隱，有所規益者，豈惟獎激弗加，蓋亦罕見施用；

translations.literal: Discourse is the state's wind and color; among those who loyally remonstrated without concealment and offered beneficial counsel, not only were rewards and encouragement not added—indeed they were rarely seen put into use;
translations.idiomatic: Discourse is the state's wind and color; among those who loyally remonstrated without concealment and offered beneficial counsel, not only were rewards and encouragement not added—indeed they were rarely seen put into use;

sentences.zh: 偷安取容，無所建明者，豈惟黜罰弗及，或乃遂階通顯。

translations.literal: those who sought ease and took accommodation, offering nothing constructive—not only were demotion and punishment not applied—some even advanced step by step to high prominence.
translations.idiomatic: those who sought ease and took accommodation, offering nothing constructive—not only were demotion and punishment not applied—some even advanced step by step to high prominence.

sentences.zh: 」至若勉聖學以廣聰明，教儲貳以固根本，戒宰輔大臣同寅盡瘁以濟艱難，責侍從臺諫思職盡規以宣壅蔽，防左右近習竊弄之漸，察姦憸餘黨窺伺之萌，皆懇懇爲上言之。

translations.literal: As for urging the sage's learning to broaden intelligence, instructing the heir to solidify the foundation, admonishing chief ministers and great ministers to exhaust themselves together in hardship, charging attendants, censors, and remonstrators to think of duty and fully remonstrate to remove obstruction, guarding against the gradual usurpation of those close at hand and near attendants, and detecting the sprouts of treacherous remnants watching for openings—all were earnestly spoken to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: As for urging the sage's learning to broaden intelligence, instructing the heir to solidify the foundation, admonishing chief ministers and great ministers to exhaust themselves together in hardship, charging attendants, censors, and remonstrators to think of duty and fully remonstrate to remove obstruction, guarding against the gradual usurpation of those close at hand and near attendants, and detecting the sprouts of treacherous remnants watching for openings—all were earnestly spoken to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 請外，知江州。

translations.literal: He requested an outside post and was made prefect of Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He requested an outside post and was made prefect of Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 郡民歲苦和糴，崇憲疏於朝，永蠲之。

translations.literal: The prefecture's people yearly suffered from harmonized grain purchases; Chongxian memorialized to the court and had it permanently abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture's people yearly suffered from harmonized grain purchases; Chongxian memorialized to the court and had it permanently abolished.

sentences.zh: 且轉糴旁郡穀別廩儲之，以備歲儉。

translations.literal: He also transferred grain from neighboring prefectures and stored it in a separate granary to prepare for years of scarcity.
translations.idiomatic: He also transferred grain from neighboring prefectures and stored it in a separate granary to prepare for years of scarcity.

sentences.zh: 瑞昌民負茶引錢，新舊累積，爲緡十七萬有奇，皆困不能償，死則以責其子孫猶弗貸。

translations.literal: The people of Ruichang owed tea certificate money; old and new debts accumulated to more than one hundred and seventy thousand strings of cash; all were trapped and unable to repay; when they died the debt was still charged to their sons and grandsons and still not forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Ruichang owed tea certificate money; old and new debts accumulated to more than one hundred and seventy thousand strings of cash; all were trapped and unable to repay; when they died the debt was still charged to their sons and grandsons and still not forgiven.

sentences.zh: 會新券行，視舊價幾倍蓰，崇憲歎曰：「負茶之民愈困矣。

translations.literal: When new certificates were issued, the price compared with the old was nearly several times greater; Chongxian sighed and said: "The people who owe tea will be still more trapped."
translations.idiomatic: When new certificates were issued, the price compared with the old was nearly several times greater; Chongxian sighed and said, "The people who owe tea will be still more trapped."

sentences.zh: 」亟請以新券一償舊券二，詔從之。

translations.literal: He urgently requested that one new certificate repay two old certificates; an edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: He urgently requested that one new certificate repay two old certificates; an edict approved it.

sentences.zh: 蓋受賜者千餘家，刻石以紀其事。

translations.literal: Those who received the benefit numbered more than a thousand households; a stone was carved to record the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Those who received the benefit numbered more than a thousand households; a stone was carved to record the affair.

sentences.zh: 修陂塘以廣溉灌，凡數千所。

translations.literal: He repaired embankments and ponds to broaden irrigation—altogether several thousand places.
translations.idiomatic: He repaired embankments and ponds to broaden irrigation—altogether several thousand places.

sentences.zh: 提舉江西常平兼權隆興府及帥漕司事，遷轉運判官仍兼帥事。

translations.literal: He was made Superintendent of Jiangxi Ever-Normal Granary while concurrently holding the offices of Longxing Prefecture and the military transport and command agencies, and was promoted to transport commissioner while still concurrently commanding.
translations.idiomatic: He was made superintendent of Jiangxi Ever-Normal Granary while concurrently holding the offices of Longxing Prefecture and the military transport and command agencies, and was promoted to transport commissioner while still concurrently commanding.

sentences.zh: 初，汝愚捐私錢百餘萬創養濟院，俾四方賓旅之疾病者得藥與食，歲久寖移爲它用。

translations.literal: Earlier Ruyu had donated more than a million in private funds to establish a Relief and Nourishment Hall, so that travelers from the four directions who fell ill could obtain medicine and food; over the years it gradually shifted to other uses.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Ruyu had donated more than a million in private funds to establish a Relief and Nourishment Hall, so that travelers from the four directions who fell ill could obtain medicine and food; over the years it gradually shifted to other uses.

sentences.zh: 崇憲至，尋修復，立規約數十條，以愈疾之多寡爲賞罰。

translations.literal: When Chongxian arrived he soon restored it, established several dozen regulations, and used the number cured as the basis for reward and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When Chongxian arrived he soon restored it, established several dozen regulations, and used the number cured as the basis for reward and punishment.

sentences.zh: 棄兒于道者，亦收鞠之。

translations.literal: Abandoned infants left on the road were also taken in and reared.
translations.idiomatic: Abandoned infants left on the road were also taken in and reared.

sentences.zh: 社倉久敝，訪其利害而更張之。

translations.literal: The community granaries had long been dilapidated; he investigated their advantages and harms and reorganized them.
translations.idiomatic: The community granaries had long been dilapidated; he investigated their advantages and harms and reorganized them.

sentences.zh: 以兵部郎中召，尋改司封，皆固辭，遂直祕閣、知靜江府、廣西經略安撫。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Director in the Ministry of War, soon changed to Director of Seals, all firmly declined, and was then made Direct Attendant at the Secretariat, prefect of Jingjiang Prefecture, and Guangxi Military Commissioner and Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as director in the Ministry of War, soon changed to director of seals, all firmly declined, and was then made direct attendant at the Secretariat, prefect of Jingjiang Prefecture, and Guangxi military commissioner and pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 靜江之屬邑十，地肥磽略等，而陽朔、修仁、荔浦之賦獨倍焉。

translations.literal: Jingjiang had ten subordinate districts; the land's fertility and barrenness were roughly equal, yet the levies of Yangshuo, Xiuren, and Lipu alone were doubled.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjiang had ten subordinate districts; the land's fertility and barrenness were roughly equal, yet the levies of Yangshuo, Xiuren, and Lipu alone were doubled.

sentences.zh: 自張栻奏減之餘，人猶以爲病。

translations.literal: Since Zhang Shi's memorial requesting reduction, people still considered it a hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Since Zhang Shi's memorial requesting reduction, people still considered it a hardship.

sentences.zh: 崇憲請再加蠲減，詔遞損有差，三縣民立祠刻石。

translations.literal: Chongxian requested further reduction and exemption; an edict ordered successive reductions by degrees; the people of the three districts erected shrines and carved stone.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxian requested further reduction and exemption; an edict ordered successive reductions by degrees; the people of the three districts erected shrines and carved stone.

sentences.zh: 瓊守非才，激黎峒之變，乃劾去之，改辟能者代其任。

translations.literal: The Qiong prefect was without talent and provoked the Li cave tribes into revolt; he impeached and removed him and changed recruitment to appoint a capable man to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: The Qiong prefect was without talent and provoked the Li cave tribes into revolt; he impeached and removed him and changed recruitment to appoint a capable man to replace him.

sentences.zh: 蘿蔓峒者仍歲寇鈔爲暴，實民何向父子陰誘導之。

translations.literal: The Luoman cave people for successive years raided and plundered as bandits; in fact the commoner He Xiang, father and son, secretly induced and guided them.
translations.idiomatic: The Luoman cave people for successive years raided and plundered as bandits; in fact the commoner He Xiang, father and son, secretly induced and guided them.

sentences.zh: 崇憲捐金繒付小校使繫以來，置之法。

translations.literal: Chongxian gave gold and silks to a petty officer to have them seized and brought in, and they were punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxian gave gold and silks to a petty officer to have them seized and brought in, and they were punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 因嚴民夷交通之禁，使邊民相什伍，寇至則鳴鼓召衆，先後掩擊，俘獲者賞，不至者有懲。

translations.literal: He thereupon strictly prohibited communication between commoners and barbarians, made border people form groups of ten households, and when bandits came they beat drums to summon the crowd; first and last they struck together in ambush; captives were rewarded, those who did not come were punished.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon strictly prohibited communication between commoners and barbarians, made border people form groups of ten households, and when bandits came they beat drums to summon the crowd; first and last they struck together in ambush; captives were rewarded, those who did not come were punished.

sentences.zh: 先是，部內郡邑有警，輒移統府兵戍之，在宜州者百人，古縣半之。

translations.literal: Previously, when districts within the jurisdiction had alarms they would shift unified prefecture troops to garrison them; at Yizhou there were a hundred men, at Gu County half that number.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, when districts within the jurisdiction had alarms they would shift unified prefecture troops to garrison them; at Yizhou there were a hundred men, at Gu County half that number.

sentences.zh: 崇憲謂根本單虛，非所以窒姦萌，乃於其地各置兵如戍兵之數，而斂戍者以歸。

translations.literal: Chongxian said the root was isolated and empty and this was not the way to block treacherous sprouts; he therefore placed troops at each place in numbers like the garrison troops and gathered the garrison troops back.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxian said the root was isolated and empty and this was not the way to block treacherous sprouts; he therefore placed troops at each place in numbers like the garrison troops and gathered the garrison troops back.

sentences.zh: 邕爲邊要害地，自狄青平儂智高，所以設捍防者甚至，歲久浸弛，而溪峒日強。

translations.literal: Yong was a key border place; since Di Qing pacified Nong Zhigao, the defenses set up were very extensive; over the years they gradually slackened while the stream caves daily grew stronger.
translations.idiomatic: Yong was a key border place; since Di Qing pacified Nong Zhigao, the defenses set up were very extensive; over the years they gradually slackened while the stream caves daily grew stronger.

sentences.zh: 崇憲條上其議，朝廷頗采其言，然未及盡用也。

translations.literal: Chongxian itemized his proposals and presented them; the court largely adopted his words, but they were not fully put into use.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxian itemized his proposals and presented them; the court largely adopted his words, but they were not fully put into use.

sentences.zh: 崇憲天性篤孝，居父喪，月餘始食食，小祥始茹果實，終喪不飲酒食肉，比御猶弗入者久之。

translations.literal: Chongxian was filial by inborn nature; while in mourning for his father, more than a month passed before he first ate food; at the small felicitations he first tasted fruit; through the full mourning he did not drink wine or eat meat; for a long time he would not even enter the women's quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxian was filial by inborn nature; while in mourning for his father, more than a month passed before he first ate food; at the small felicitations he first tasted fruit; through the full mourning he did not drink wine or eat meat; for a long time he would not even enter the women's quarters.

sentences.zh: 論曰：自昔大臣處危疑之地，而能免於禍難者蓋鮮矣。

translations.literal: Commentary says: From antiquity, great ministers placed in situations of peril and doubt have rarely been able to escape calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary says: From antiquity, great ministers placed in situations of peril and doubt have rarely been able to escape calamity.

sentences.zh: 昔者周成王立而幼沖，周公以王室懿親爲宰輔，四國流言，而周公不免于居東之憂，非天降風雷之變，以彰周公之德而啟成王之衷，則所謂《金滕》之書，固無因而關於王之耳目，公之心果能以自明乎？

translations.literal: In former times King Cheng of Zhou was established while young and immature; the Duke of Zhou, as a close relative of the royal house serving as chief minister, faced slander from the four states, and the Duke could not avoid the worry of dwelling in the east; if heaven had not sent the change of wind and thunder to manifest the Duke's virtue and open King Cheng's heart, then the so-called document of the Metal Casket would have had no occasion to reach the king's ears—could the Duke's heart truly have made itself clear on its own?
translations.idiomatic: In former times King Cheng of Zhou was established while young and immature; the Duke of Zhou, as a close relative of the royal house serving as chief minister, faced slander from the four states, and the Duke could not avoid the worry of dwelling in the east; if heaven had not sent the change of wind and thunder to manifest the Duke's virtue and open King Cheng's heart, then the so-called document of the Metal Casket would have had no occasion to reach the king's ears—could the Duke's heart truly have made itself clear on its own?

sentences.zh: 公之心能自明，則天意之所以屬於周而綿八百載之丕祚者，實係於茲。

translations.literal: If the Duke's heart could make itself clear, then the intent of heaven in entrusting Zhou and continuing its eight-hundred-year great fortune truly depended on this.
translations.idiomatic: If the Duke's heart could make itself clear, then the intent of heaven in entrusting Zhou and continuing its eight-hundred-year great fortune truly depended on this.

sentences.zh: 不然，周其殆哉！

translations.literal: Otherwise Zhou would have been in peril!
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise Zhou would have been in peril!

sentences.zh: 趙汝愚，宋之宗臣也，其賢固不及周公，其位與戚又非若周公之尊且昵也。

translations.literal: Zhao Ruyu was a clansman of Song; his worth cannot compare with the Duke of Zhou, and his position and kinship are not so honored and intimate as the Duke's.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ruyu was a clansman of Song; his worth cannot compare with the Duke of Zhou, and his position and kinship are not so honored and intimate as the Duke's.

sentences.zh: 方孝宗崩，光宗疾，大喪無主，中外洶洶，一時大臣有畏難而去者矣。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong died and Guangzong was ill, the great mourning had no master; within and without there was uproar; among the great ministers of the time there were those who feared difficulty and left.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong died and Guangzong was ill, the great mourning had no master; within and without there was uproar; among the great ministers of the time there were those who feared difficulty and left.

sentences.zh: 汝愚獨能奮不慮身，定大計於頃刻，收召明德之士，以輔寧宗之新政，天下翕然望治，其功可謂盛矣。

translations.literal: Ruyu alone was able to rouse himself without considering his person, settle the great plan in a moment, recall men of bright virtue to assist Ningzong's new government—the realm together looked to good order; his achievement can be called magnificent.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu alone was able to rouse himself without considering his person, settle the great plan in a moment, recall men of bright virtue to assist Ningzong's new government—the realm together looked to good order; his achievement can be called magnificent.

sentences.zh: 然不幾時，卒爲韓侂胄所構，一斥而遂不復返，天下聞而冤之。

translations.literal: Yet before long he was framed by Han Tuozhou, driven out once and never able to return; the realm heard of it and considered it unjust.
translations.idiomatic: Yet before long he was framed by Han Tuozhou, driven out once and never able to return; the realm heard of it and considered it unjust.

sentences.zh: 于此見天之所以眷宋者不如周，而宋之陵夷馴至於不可爲，信非人力之所能也。

translations.literal: From this one sees that heaven's favor toward Song was not like that toward Zhou, and Song's decline proceeding step by step to the point where nothing could be done—truly it was not within human power.
translations.idiomatic: From this one sees that heaven's favor toward Song was not like that toward Zhou, and Song's decline proceeding step by step to the point where nothing could be done—truly it was not within human power.

sentences.zh: 汝愚父以純孝聞，而子崇憲能守家法，所至有惠政，亦可謂世濟其美者已。

translations.literal: Ruyu's father was known for pure filial piety, and his son Chongxian was able to keep the family law; wherever he went he had benevolent government—this too can be called passing beauty down through generations.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyu's father was known for pure filial piety, and his son Chongxian was able to keep the family law; wherever he went he had benevolent government—this too can be called passing beauty down through generations.
